Case ID: 1124
Case Type: Shipping Claim
Date: 2025-03-29
Handled By: Claims - Javier Costa
Customer or Requestor: Nina Olsen
Title: Carrier marked parcel delivered to wrong address cluster

Issue Description
Customer reported that tracking showed the order as delivered, but the delivery photo and apartment number in the carrier notes did not match the order address.

Steps Taken
- Validated the shipping label and confirmed the company transmitted the correct destination details.
- Compared carrier GPS delivery data with the apartment complex location and identified a mismatch.
- Requested a carrier trace and reviewed local delivery patterns for similar route issues.
- Worked with Customer Support to keep the customer updated while the claim was under review.

Resolution
Approved a lost-package replacement because the evidence showed the carrier misdelivered the parcel, then filed a delivery error claim with the carrier.

Follow-Up
Carrier Relations escalated the recurring route issue to the regional delivery manager.

Reference Documents
- Lost Shipment Runbook v3
- Shipping Exception Runbook v2
